capabilities.acceptance_test: Regenerate a city twice; compare receipts and current primary identities.
capabilities.decision: Current266city planning; former route editor is not restored.
capabilities.title: Deterministic city generation

capabilities.acceptance_test: Verify1km resource schedule, procurement dates and monthly finance; reject revision mismatches.
capabilities.decision: Pilot resource schedule, procurement and monthly cash replace the old delivery model; catalogue-wide ERP twins remain open.
capabilities.title: Generatable project digital twin

capabilities.acceptance_test: Open current pilot and native authenticated workflow; preserve permissions and reject unsafe paths.
capabilities.decision: Current evidence review plus isolated native pilot; full former GIS/OCC/HR navigation is unconnected.
capabilities.title: Integrated Workbench

capabilities.acceptance_test: Purchase, simulated receiving, QA/rework, install, alarm, maintenance, replacement and independent handback; test restart/revision faults.
capabilities.decision: Test scope is serial cartridge and beam simulation in native ERPNext/FUXA; entire-city HR/accounts and evaluator bindings remain open.
capabilities.title: Business execution and embedded maintenance

capabilities.acceptance_test: Restore editable maglev route/service revisions with GIS provenance and merge/review tests.
capabilities.decision: The current front door is read-only; the former16layer editor and OD revision UI are absent.
capabilities.title: Interactive network and service planning

capabilities.acceptance_test: Replay exact equipment identity through Rust loops and coupled plant with adverse controls and energy accounting.
capabilities.decision: Current Rust support/current/launch loops and bounded plant replace wheel-specific interfaces; physical plant validation stays open.
capabilities.title: Software in the loop

capabilities.acceptance_test: Generate same-stop SUMO demand/dwell scenario and compare timings within a declared bound.
capabilities.decision: Independent SUMO timing cross-check is not migrated; Rust/Python comparisons are not SUMO evidence.
capabilities.title: Independent operations cross-check

capabilities.acceptance_test: Reconcile serial/typeIDs, quantities and field records through IFC/IDS/BCF without autoaccepting estimates.
capabilities.decision: Current plans retain geography; complete IFC4.3/IDS/BCF and field acceptance federation is unconnected.
capabilities.title: Civil BIM, GIS and field evidence

capabilities.acceptance_test: Reconcile current units, interfaces, lifting and QA plans; retain clearance/supplier holds.
capabilities.decision: Current guidebeam/hub definitions replace old platform and bogie-change products; all45former families are not reproduced.
capabilities.title: Station and civil product geometry

capabilities.acceptance_test: Retain solver inputs, failures and flow/adverse cases on current interfaces; qualify fire/drainage separately.
capabilities.decision: Current structural/access screens replace old benchmarks; complete fire/drainage/thermal qualification remains open.
capabilities.title: Station engineering screens

capabilities.acceptance_test: Reconcile scope-exclusive mass/cost/space; test equipped bay assembly/removal, retain failures.
capabilities.decision: Current composite body and magnetic bays replace the [historical wheel/traction product](https://github.com/modernecotech/OpenSourceRail/blob/205e8dc158c83fcdc2dca9ceb8bad0a7e8b3f61e/README.md); stock geometry is not a manufactured train release.
capabilities.title: Buildable modular trainset

capabilities.acceptance_test: Reconcile quantities/monthly cash, funding gap, DSCR and independent comparison quantities without principal double count.
capabilities.decision: Pilot quantities and computed launch losses feed cash/revenue/debt sensitivities; catalogue allowances retain their separate identity.
capabilities.title: Automatic cost propagation

capabilities.acceptance_test: Execute authority and maglev refusal proofs with stale/tamper and independent handback negative controls.
capabilities.decision: Executed authority and maglev refusal properties are source-bound; they do not provide physical or operational acceptance.
capabilities.title: Operations and assurance

capabilities.acceptance_test: Run native scenario/browser, outage/restart and revision faults; retain source receipts/screenshots.
capabilities.decision: Current disposable native scenario exercises ERPNext/FUXA/Workbench with faults/recovery; broad former editor coverage is not restored.
capabilities.title: Deterministic integrated testing
